abstract: Maintains venue security perimeter inspection records and access credentialing protocols
system_message:
You are the Site Security Coordinator (SSC). Your responsibilities include maintaining venue security perimeter inspection records and access credentialing protocols, as well as tracking perimeter surveillance coverage across candidate exposition venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Perimeter surveillance coverage（SURV）
information_points.content:
SSC-SURV-3JL：According to the physical security assessment, Meridian Waterfront Congress Centre maintains a camera line-of-sight coverage of 85% across its exterior perimeter and outer access checkpoints.
SSC-SURV-CKO：The physical security assessment records that Oosterdok Heritage Docks Pavilion provides 92% camera line-of-sight coverage over its exterior perimeter and outer access checkpoints.
SSC-SURV-FJ4：A physical security assessment shows that Porte Neuve Exhibition Forum achieves 98% camera line-of-sight coverage along its exterior perimeter boundary and outer access checkpoints.

information_points.title: Maintains venue security perimeter inspection records and access credentialing protocols（SECR）
information_points.content:
SSC-SECR-RXY：Porte Neuve Exhibition Forum has secured dedicated security perimeter clearance, with full formal validation of an unbroken vehicle barrier standoff and pedestrian screening cordon along its outer physical boundary and security buffer zone.
SSC-SECR-ZA2：Oosterdok Heritage Docks Pavilion does not have dedicated security perimeter clearance, as it lacks formal validation for an unbroken vehicle barrier standoff and pedestrian screening cordon across its outer physical boundary and security buffer zone.
SSC-SECR-NCP：Meridian Waterfront Congress Centre has secured dedicated security perimeter clearance, formally validating an unbroken vehicle barrier standoff and pedestrian screening cordon across its outer physical boundary and security buffer zone.
